mode: Built-in ImageGen; new drawings with character/style references, no reuse of old field artwork

jobs.prompt:
Create an ENTIRELY NEW production-ready JRPG overworld walking sprite sheet, drawn from scratch. Image1 is character identity/clothing reference ONLY. Image2 is proportions/style reference ONLY, not an edit target: do NOT reuse, trace, splice or repair any old sprite pixels. Restore that compact small DS-era super-deformed pixel-art style, NOT tall HD-2D proportions. BOY Chuheun: tousled ash-gray brown hair, amber eyes, black martial wrap jacket with cobalt-blue lapel/cuffs/hem and white inner collar, BLACK tied waist sash, short ORANGE vertical accent at front, baggy black pants, ORANGE AND WHITE sneakers. Small dark-blue steel chain bracelet at left wrist. Friendly confident expression.
Sheet exactly THREE equal columns by FOUR equal rows, 12 entire-body drawings. Row1 faces camera/down; row2 faces screen-left; row3 faces screen-right; row4 faces away/up. In EACH row: column1 standing feet together (neutral passing pose); column2 walking with character's LEFT foot forward, RIGHT foot back, RIGHT arm forward; column3 walking with RIGHT foot forward, LEFT foot back, LEFT arm forward. Two clearly opposite foot contacts, small natural walking strides, no running, jumping or high knees. Alternate the leg closest to viewer in side views; never duplicate the same leg pose twice.
All twelve poses EXACT same small chibi proportions, about 2.3 heads tall, large head approximately43% of body height, compact torso and short legs. Keep head and torso registered on same center line, same head shape/size, hairline, eye height, clothes volume. The whole intact body is redrawn for each pose, with no horizontal join or cut through waist/head. Foot ground baseline equal in every cell. No size changes or dramatic torso rotation during walking. Subtle counter-swing of arms and legs, restrained hair motion.
Crisp true pixel-art clusters, limited palette, dark clean outline, softly shaded forms in deliberate pixels, readable at ~58px total character height. Avoid glossy smooth illustration and painterly blur.
Uniform transparent gutters around every pose, at least20% of cell width and12% cell height blank. Entire hairstyle, hands, boots and short wrist chain inside own cell. Do not draw dangling floor chains, shadows, sparkles, background, grids, labels, letters or borders. Background must be transparent alpha0. These are compact overworld sprites, not battle sprites.
